name: decline sit up (arms straight)
description: A sit-up on a decline bench with your arms held straight out in front. It trains the abs through a longer range, and straight arms make it a bit harder.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, parallel to the floor.
Curl your torso up, rolling off the bench one section at a time.
Reach your arms toward your knees as you sit up.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Keep your chin off your chest and don't yank with your arms.
